Hi team — attaching the detailed usage export and the draft invoice showing line items. Summary below: 

- Period considered: 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-30 (contract term ended 2026-06-30)
- Contracted committed capacity: 150k tokens/day average (monthly commit equivalent)
- Actual billed usage: billing system shows an effective 210k tokens/day average across the period (this includes a short burst on 2026-06-22)
- Excess consumption = 60k tokens/day * 61 days => gross overage tokens = 3,660,000 tokens
- Unit rate (per contract): $0.005/token => gross overage = $18,300. We also applied rounding/prorations and a late reconciliation fee of $450 per contract terms, giving the $18,750 on the invoice.

We can present two options to FinTech Labs: 
1) One-time true-up invoice (current): $18,750 due on receipt.
2) Amortized: split into two equal charges of $9,375 on the July and August invoices; no change to total. Both options are contract-compliant.

I attached: usage-breakdown-CY2026-Q2.csv and FTL_topup_invoice_draft.pdf. If they want a different amortization (three months), we can recalculate.

Naomi Feldman
